title.from: MoM rollout: schedule, then announce 5-star Stories, test account first
title.to: MoM rollout: scheduling, then 5-star announcements (dry run, then one watched live post)

description.from:
Part of the scheduled publishing and announcements epic. Design: docs/plans/scheduled-publishing-and-announcements.md ("Testing safely", "Questions for Ryan").

Goal: Machines on Machines uses scheduling, then announces 5-star Articles on X: first on a protected test account Ryan owns, with approval required and a budget Ryan enters; then on MoM's real account; then Ryan reviews the rate and the floor.

Steps: set `publication.timeZone`; deploy scheduling; schedule one real Story; Ryan creates MoM's X developer app and buys credits, sets X's console spending limit; connect the protected test account; confirm the Automated label; set rules (Articles, 5 stars, approval required) and the budget; post and review; switch to the real account; after a month, review the rate (about zero today) and decide whether to lower the floor or switch to automatic approval. Only the site under test is bumped; other sites follow in one batch once it works.

Depends on: all other stories in this epic; the notifications plugin on MoM (PPY-824c14).

```gherkin
Feature: Machines on Machines schedules and announces its best Stories
  MoM proves the feature: scheduled Stories go out on time and its 5-star Stories
  are announced on X, safely, within budget.

  Scenario: A test account first
    Given MoM is connected to a protected X account that Ryan owns
    When a 5-star Article is published and Sam approves its post
    Then the post appears only on the protected account
    And its cost shows in MoM's spend

  Scenario: Switching to the real account
    Given the test posts looked right to Ryan
    When Ryan disconnects the test account and connects MoM's account
    Then the next approved announcement appears on MoM's account

  Scenario: Reviewing the rate
    Given a month of announcements on MoM
    Then the admin page shows how many Stories qualified, how many were posted and what they cost
    And Ryan decides whether to keep 5 stars or include 4
```

Open questions: the test account's handle; MoM's budget; when to switch approval to automatic.
description.to:
Part of the scheduled publishing and announcements epic. Design: docs/plans/scheduled-publishing-and-announcements.md ("Testing safely", "Questions for Ryan").

Goal: Machines on Machines uses scheduling, then announces 5-star Stories on X from its own account: dry run first, then one live post Ryan watches, with a $10 budget per X billing cycle; then Ryan reviews the rate and the floor. No test account (Ryan, 2026-11-12).

Steps: set `publication.timeZone`; deploy scheduling; schedule one real Story; Ryan confirms MoM's X account exists (open item) and follows docs/x-announcements-setup.md: developer app, $10 credits, $10 console spending limit, keys entered in Administration, connect, Automated label; set rules (Stories, 5 stars) and budget $10; mode Dry run and review the built posts; prove pause, budget and disconnected guards in dry run; Ryan rates a Story 5 stars, schedules it for a time he is watching, sets mode On, checks the post on X with Pause and Withdraw at hand; retirement handling (PPY-bf9d26) shipped before mode stays On; after a month, review the rate (about zero today) and the floor.

Cannot be tested without posting: X accepting the post (tweet.write), X's length and link handling, the link card on X, duplicate refusals, rate-limit answers, the delete path, the Automated label display, X's bill versus our counter. The watched first post covers the first four. Only the site under test is bumped; other sites follow in one batch once it works.

Depends on: all other stories in this epic; the notifications plugin on MoM (PPY-824c14).

```gherkin
Feature: Machines on Machines schedules and announces its best Stories
  MoM proves the feature: scheduled Stories go out on time and its 5-star Stories
  are announced on X, safely, within budget.

  Scenario: Dry run first
    Given MoM is connected and its mode is Dry run
    When a 5-star Article is published
    Then Ryan sees the exact post that would be made
    And nothing is posted or spent

  Scenario: The guards hold before going live
    Given MoM's mode is Dry run
    When Ryan pauses announcements, or the budget is below one post's price, or the account is disconnected
    Then the next eligible Story is recorded as blocked with that reason

  Scenario: One watched live post
    Given Ryan rated an Article 5 stars and scheduled it for 10:00
    And MoM's mode is On
    When 10:00 arrives
    Then one post appears on MoM's X account with the Article's link
    And its $0.20 cost shows in MoM's spend
    And Ryan can pause or withdraw it from the same page

  Scenario: Reviewing the rate
    Given a month of announcements on MoM
    Then the admin page shows how many Stories qualified, how many were posted and what they cost
    And Ryan decides whether to keep 5 stars or include 4
```

Open questions: does MoM's X account exist, and its handle (Ryan)?
